cases.text: Invoice RG-18. Issue date 2026-05-02. Supplier Riverglass Studio. Customer Cedar Lab. Design services USD 950. Total due USD 950, payable within 30 days.
Service agreement between Willow Archive and Cedar Lab. Both parties have signed. The archive supplies cataloguing services for six months. Either party may terminate on 20 days written notice.
Cedar Lab visitor policy. Every visitor must sign in and wear a temporary badge. The host must accompany visitors in the specimen room. Exceptions require the lab manager's approval.
Cedar Lab field report, 2026-05-04. We examined 12 sampling locations. Eight passed the moisture threshold and four require repeat measurements. The team completed the planned survey.
From: Taylor at Cedar Lab. To: Rowan. Subject: Tuesday meeting. Hello Rowan, please bring the draft agenda on Tuesday. We will choose the next field visit date then. Thanks, Taylor.
A recipe for pear compote. Slice four pears, add a spoon of sugar and a little water, and simmer for fifteen minutes. Serve warm with oats.

From: Rowan. To: Cedar Lab. Subject: proposed service agreement. Draft terms: six months of cataloguing for USD 400 per month. Please reply to accept; we have not yet approved these terms. This email includes an unsigned agreement draft.
